title: Reduce DOM and ARIA overhead for mini timeseries overview components
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Mini/multi-series time-series components (sparklines, compact overviews, and micro charts used in dashboards and table rows) are generating large DOM footprints and verbose ARIA announcements. This ticket defines a design-first approach to reduce DOM node count, simplify ARIA semantics for screen readers, and provide token-friendly compact variants that meet WCAG 2.1 AA while improving render latency on low-powered devices.
background: Usage: these components appear in high-density lists (customer lists, route-level summaries, per-model dashboards) where there are often 50–300 charts on a single page. Current implementations render individual SVG groups for every series + nested tooltip containers and build a separate live-region for each chart which leads to slow initial paint, high memory, and noisy NVDA/VoiceOver outputs. Engineering perf traces show long layout/paint times on iPhone SE and older laptops. PMs have reported higher churn in pages with many mini charts due to perceived slowness and accessibility teams flagged redundant ARIA presentation for each data point.
acceptance_criteria: Reduce DOM node count for an average 4-series mini chart by >= 55% vs current baseline
Single shared ARIA live-region pattern for chart summaries that produces one concise announcement per chart update (target NVDA announcement latency < 300ms)
Compact variants use existing design tokens (spacing, strokeWidth, color tokens) and introduce at most two new tokens for micro-mode density
No regression in keyboard navigation: focus order preserved, chart focusable element size >= 32x32px unless explicitly opt-out
Automated visual and a11y regressions run in CI (percy + axe) with pass criteria enabled for affected stories
Perf benchmark: initial full-page render (100 mini charts) reduces Time To Interactive (TTI) by at least 25% on target test machines (see links)
design_notes: Replace per-chart offscreen DOM tooltips with a single portal-managed tooltip container that repositions for visible chart on hover/focus
Flatten SVG groups for multi-series render: combine static grid and axes into a single shared canvas layer and use path merging for series where color and stroke allow
Introduce 'micro' tokens: token.microGap and token.microStroke that map to existing token palette but allow explicit overrides for dense contexts
Use aria-describedby to point to a generated summary element rather than live-rendering verbose point-by-point announcements
Provide two a11y modes: 'announce-on-update' (single concise summary) and 'announce-on-focus' (read summary when chart receives keyboard focus)

Document trade-offs: merging paths reduces per-node semantics (individual series not directly addressable). Provide an opt-in per-chart flag to preserve series-level nodes for interactive editing workflows
decisions: Adopt a portal-based shared tooltip/live-region across the dashboard instead of per-chart live regions
Default mini charts to 'announce-on-update' to reduce noise; dashboards with heavy reader workflows can opt into 'announce-on-focus'
Introduce two new design tokens (microGap, microStroke) kept as aliases to existing tokens for backward compatibility
Performance-first rendering will favor canvas/path-merged SVG for high-density contexts; keep accessible fallback for single-chart pages

Proto: build a lightweight interactive prototype (React story) demonstrating merged-path rendering and shared tooltip/live-region (owner: Liam)
A11y: run screen reader script with NVDA and VoiceOver, capture announcement timings and transcripts (owner: Marina Lopez)
Engineering: implement shared portal tooltip + live-region and micro tokens in chart library (owner: ENG-5821)
Perf: benchmark baseline vs optimized on target lab machines and mobile device emulation, record TTI/paint/CPU (owner: EngPerf)
Docs: update design system docs with migration guide and token mapping for micro variants (owner: Documentation)
QA: add Percy snapshots and axe checks to CI for affected stories (owner: QA)
Rollout: feature flag micro-mode and staged release with telemetry to monitor errors and focus/announce rates
notes_for_engineering: Prefer passive event listeners for hover/pan interactions to avoid main-thread jank
Allow server-side prerender of grid/axes for initial paint where data is static
Expose token.microGap and token.microStroke in theme provider with default fallbacks to neutralGap and thinStroke
Keep an opt-in prop preserveSeriesNodes to retain per-series DOM nodes for editing screens; default false for dashboards
